commits.message:
feat: implement --fix, storage_write_without_read, inefficient_bytes_concat, map_insert_in_loop lints

Closes #58 - implement --fix flag for cargo-cost-lint to automatically apply machine-applicable suggestions
Closes #63 - add positive/negative fixtures for map_insert_in_loop lint
Closes #64 - add positive/negative fixtures for inefficient_bytes_concat lint
Closes #65 - add positive/negative fixtures for storage_write_without_read lint

- Add --fix CLI flag to cargo-cost-lint that applies machine-applicable suggestions in-place
- Add STORAGE_WRITE_WITHOUT_READ lint detecting storage writes without corresponding reads
- Add INEFFICIENT_BYTES_CONCAT lint detecting Bytes concatenation in loops
- Add MAP_INSERT_IN_LOOP lint detecting Map::insert inside loops
- Add UI test fixtures (positive and negative) for all three new lints
- Add documentation for all new lints
- Update README.md and CHANGELOG.md

ci: fix rustfmt formatting issues

Align with rustfmt output for:
- cargo-cost-lint/src/main.rs: file_edits block
- soroban_cost_lints/src/lib.rs: check_fn signature, visitor initialization, has_read formatting

fix: compilation errors from CI

- Fix check_fn signature: add missing FnDecl and LocalDefId parameters
- Fix self.cx → &self.cx in visitor impls (visitor takes &self)
- Fix hir::ExprKind::BinaryOp → hir::ExprKind::Binary
- Fix FnKind from hir::FnKind to rustc_hir::intravisit::FnKind
- Simplify inefficient_bytes_concat lint logic
ci: fix rustfmt formatting for key_snippet lines

fix: visitor cx field should be a reference to LateContext

StorageWriteWithoutRead visitors store cx as &[LateContext] since
check_fn receives cx by reference
fix: add separate lifetime for visitor cx reference to satisfy invariance
fix: satisfy rustfmt for storage write lint
fix: resolve clippy warnings in storage write lint
test: make ui test compile after adding storage_write_without_read fixtures
merge: integrate upstream bytes_append_in_loop lint (#226); keep all 4 lints and merge related fixtures
